test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: HJEI is related to OQLP in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, JLGK is related to QSNR. To which of the following is LNIM related, following the same logic?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Each letter is shifted by +7 from its positional value to get the next word

⇒ HJEI : OQLP ⇒ H(+7)=O, J(+7)=Q, E(+7)=L, I(+7)=P

⇒ JLGK : QSNR ⇒ J(+7)=Q, L(+7)=S, G(+7)=N, K(+7)=R

Similarly,

⇒ LNIM: SUPT ⇒ L(+7)=S, N(+7)=U, I(+7)=P, M(+7)=T

**∴ The correct answer is Option (2).**
